user.title: Set up HASS Console
user.description: Tell HASS Console where to write the CSV log files. Add your LOG and ALARM points from the integration card after setup — the Console YAML path is optional and only used for legacy console.yaml configs.

error.yaml_not_found: Console YAML file not found at the given path
error.parent_not_writable: Parent directory does not exist and could not be created

abort.single_instance_allowed: HASS Console is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

init.title: HASS Console settings
init.description: Change file paths and retention. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.

error.yaml_not_found: Console YAML file not found at the given path
error.parent_not_writable: Parent directory does not exist and could not be created

user.title: Add LOG point
user.description: A LOG point reads an entity's state on a cron schedule and writes it to the log CSV.

data.name: Point name (uppercase, becomes part of the entity ID)
data.cron: Cron schedule (5 fields, e.g. "0 0 * * *" for daily midnight)
data.note: Note (optional — static text in the Note column)
data.target_csv: Custom CSV file (optional — bare filename or absolute path)

reconfigure.title: Edit LOG point
reconfigure.description: Rename or update this LOG point. Changes take effect immediately.

error.name_taken: Another point already uses this name

user.title: Add ALARM point
user.description: An ALARM point watches entities in real time and fires when a condition holds for a sustained duration. First, name and classify it — you'll add triggers on the next screen.

data.name: Point name (uppercase, becomes part of the entity ID)
data.note: Note (optional — static text in the Note column)
data.target_csv: Custom CSV file (optional — bare filename or absolute path)

reconfigure.title: Edit ALARM point
reconfigure.description: Update the header for this ALARM point, then edit its triggers on the next screen.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: An ALARM point needs at least one trigger. Add, edit, or remove triggers below, then save.

add_trigger.title: Add trigger
add_trigger.description: A trigger fires when its primary condition is met. Use numeric_state for above/below thresholds, or state for exact matches. The 'for' duration is how long the condition must hold before the alarm is recorded (0 = fire immediately).

data.alias: Alias (optional — shown in the Trigger column and in this list)
data.above: Above (numeric_state — leave blank if using below)
data.below: Below (numeric_state — leave blank if using above)

edit_trigger.title: Edit trigger
edit_trigger.description: Update this trigger's settings. Any AND conditions already stored on this trigger are preserved (edit them in console.yaml or wait for the upcoming conditions editor).

error.name_taken: Another point already uses this name
error.numeric_needs_threshold: Numeric triggers need an 'above' or 'below' value
error.state_needs_to: State triggers need at least one 'to' value
error.at_least_one_trigger: An ALARM point needs at least one trigger before it can be saved

invalid_config.title: HASS Console: {count} invalid config point(s)

yaml_deprecated.title: HASS Console: console.yaml is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description:
{count} point(s) are still defined only in console.yaml. YAML setup is deprecated as of 3.0.0 and will be removed in a future release.

Migrate to UI-managed points: Settings → Devices & Services → HASS Console → ADD → LOG point or ALARM point.

UI-managed points appear alongside YAML points on the integration card; once every point is added through the UI, remove them from console.yaml (or delete the file) and this warning clears.
